body: An open-source framework for training and running video generation models.
plain_description: **Create high-quality videos from text prompts or reference images.** Generate and edit video at different resolutions, lengths, and aspect ratios. The project also provides tools for training and fine-tuning video models.
technical_description: Open-Sora is an open-source video generation project with text-to-video and image-to-video pipelines, video data preprocessing, inference, training, and fine-tuning. Its README describes an 11B model supporting 256px and 768px output, with single- and multi-GPU inference. Setup uses Python, PyTorch, CUDA-dependent xformers, and flash-attn; examples use H100/H800 GPUs.
title: Open-Sora
